Pip's scarf gets stuck on a bramble bush, and he's too embarrassed to call for help. #SleepyMeadowStories Oona the owl teaches him that asking for help isn't the small thing to do — it's the wise thing.

This video uses AI narration and AI-generated illustrations.

#BedtimeStory #PipTheBunny #AskForHelp #KidsStories
